title: Scene Hierarchy
description: Displays every layer and entity in the active scene as an organized tree. Use the Scene Hierarchy to switch scenes, build parent-child groups, and control rendering order.

blocks.content: The **Scene Hierarchy** panel on the left side of the editor lists every layer and entity in your active scene. It separates your scene into **World** layers that move with the camera and **User Interface** layers that stay fixed to the screen.

blocks.content: The panel contains the scene toolbar at the top, a real-time search input, and the layer tree below.

rows: Dropdown at the top of the panel that switches the active scene in the [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport).
Menu next to the scene selector with **New Scene**, **Rename Scene**, **Duplicate Scene**, **Set as Initial Scene**, and **Delete Scene**.
Filters the hierarchy tree by entity or layer **ID** as you type. Click **X** to clear the search.
Section for gameplay layers that move, zoom, and rotate with the scene camera.
Section for HUD and menu layers anchored to the screen. Its section menu includes **Open UI Editor**.
Displays the expand arrow, type icon (such as a blue box for a [prefab](components/entities_and_prefabs)), unique **ID**, **Z-Index** badge, and hover buttons for lock and visibility.

blocks.content: Right-clicking a layer or entity row opens context actions for spawning, organizing, and converting items.

rows: Spawns an **Empty Entity**, **Sprite**, **Shape**, **Text**, [Tilemap](components/renderers/tilemap), or UI element inside the layer.
Creates a new entity already parented under the clicked entity.
Saves the entity and its children as a reusable prefab in the **Prefabs** dock.
Updates the layer sorting integer. Layers with higher numbers render in front.
Prompts for a new unique **ID** (or press **F2**).
Hover over the right side of a row to lock canvas selection or toggle visibility. Locking or hiding a parent also applies to all of its children.

blocks.message: **World** entities and **User Interface** elements use different transform components ([Transform & UI Transform](components/transform)). You cannot drag a **World** entity into a **User Interface** layer, or vice versa.

blocks.content: Use the **Scene Options** menu at the top of the panel to add scenes and choose which scene loads first when your game starts.

items: At the top of the **Scene Hierarchy**, click the **Scene Options** (3-dots) button next to the scene dropdown.
Click **New Scene**, enter a scene name, and click **Create**. The editor switches to the new scene.
Click **Scene Options** again and choose **Set as Initial Scene** to make this scene the starting point for your game.

blocks.content: Drag rows in the tree to group children under a parent entity or reorder siblings.

items: In the **Scene Hierarchy**, drag the entity you want to attach over the target parent entity.
Hover over the middle of the target row until a blue border highlights the row, then release the mouse button. The entity indents under the parent.
To reorder siblings instead, hover near the top or bottom edge of a row until a horizontal blue line appears, then release.
To unparent a child entity back to the root of the layer, drag it onto the parent layer row and release.

blocks.message: Selecting a parent entity in the **Scene Hierarchy** highlights all of its children in the tree while keeping the parent's properties open in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector).

blocks.content: Use these shortcuts while working in the **Scene Hierarchy**. For the full list of editor shortcuts, see [Shortcuts Reference](interface/shortcuts).

Delete the selected entity and its children
